item.title: Charlie Kirk assassination: Why is Kash Patel under fire? Trump defends FBI director as probe faces scrutiny
item.description: President Trump defended FBI Director Kash Patel amidst scrutiny over the Charlie Kirk assassination investigation. Patel faced criticism for his handling of updates and past controversies, but the White House strongly supports his work. A suspect, Tyler Robinson, is in custody, and Patel is set to appear before Congress to address concerns about the investigation.

item.title: Charlie Kirk assassination: FBI says shooter Tyler Robinson's transgender partner 'had no idea'; fully cooperating in investigation
item.description: Tyler Robinson, accused of assassinating Charlie Kirk, had a partner who is fully cooperating with the FBI investigation. Officials confirm the partner, described as a male transitioning to female, was unaware of Robinson's alleged plan. Text messages and digital evidence seized from their shared apartment are being analyzed, as the FBI investigates all connections to the case.

item.title: 'Salami slicing': Russia's incursion into Poland - How Putin has riled Trump, again
item.description: Following a Russian drone incursion into Polish airspace, NATO scrambled jets, raising alarms across Europe. Trump's initial ambiguous response, downplaying the incident, unsettled allies who view Poland's security as vital to NATO's credibility. This event highlights concerns about Trump's commitment to defending NATO allies and his perceived hesitation in confronting Russian aggression, potentially emboldening further provocations.

item.title: Second warning: Zohran Mamdani again pledges to arrest Netanyahu if elected; also targets Putin
item.description: New York City mayoral candidate Zohran Mamdani has reiterated his pledge to arrest Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu if he enters the city, citing an International Criminal Court warrant. Mamdani accuses Netanyahu of war crimes and genocide in Gaza, a stance that has drawn criticism, especially from Jewish leaders. His rival, Andrew Cuomo, supports Israel, while Netanyahu dismisses Mamdani's threat.

item.title: Pakistan: 21-year-old woman gang-raped in Haripur Afghan refugee camp; five booked
item.description: In a shocking incident at Afghan Refugee Camp No. 16 in Haripur, a 21-year-old woman was brutally sexually assaulted by five men. The victim was allegedly dragged into nearby fields while en route to work, where she was raped for two hours, robbed of her valuables, and beaten when she resisted.

item.title: Are UAE airports rejecting passengers over minor passport damage? Here’s why this matters for your travel plans
item.description: Airlines and immigration authorities in the UAE and other strict-entry countries are rejecting passports with even minor damage, such as torn pages, stains, or faulty chips. Valid visas and unexpired documents are no longer enough. UAE airports are enforcing tougher checks, and travellers risk being denied boarding. Early renewal and careful passport handling are now essential for smooth international travel.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Charlie Kirk assassination: ‘Shy, goofy, fun to be around’ — what peers recall about shooter Tyler Robinson
item.description: Tyler Robinson, a 22-year-old with a seemingly bright future, is accused of killing Charlie Kirk. Once perceived as conservative, Robinson's views shifted, with acquaintances noting his dislike for Trump and Kirk. His immersion in gaming and online culture may have influenced disturbing messages found on rifle casings near the crime scene, revealing a complex and troubling transformation.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Balancing act: Donald Trump dines with Qatar’s PM after Israeli strike in Doha; Rubio to meet Netanyahu next
item.description: Amidst rising tensions, US President Trump hosted Qatar's Prime Minister following an Israeli strike in Doha. The meeting, preceded by high-level talks with US officials, underscores Washington's delicate balancing act. Qatar condemned the strike, vowing to protect its sovereignty, while Trump expressed his disapproval, fearing it could jeopardize ceasefire efforts.
